periods.summary: Daniel Dandalion waits on a church roof near the castle wall, correctly predicting that Ikki will choose a route that avoids hurting ordinary citizens. His Device Lionheart can create Blood Circle, a sealed one-on-one duel space, and his flexible rapier techniques counter Ikki's usual sword methods. He studies Ikki in advance and even predicts Saigeki, but Ikki defeats him through a deceptive thrown-Intetsu maneuver using the sword's wrapping cord. Daniel acknowledges that martial skill includes such cunning, concedes defeat, and entrusts Stella to Ikki.

key_events.summary: Duels Ikki on the church roof and loses.
